notes: This contract pins timestamped Send Interaction used by the portable C++ TCK to the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API. Companion API-reference contracts pin retraction and the alternate advance services. The source uses only standard RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. The scenario verifies retraction terminalization across standard advance forms without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.
